name: Mail Graph
description: Outlook.com, Hotmail, Live and Microsoft 365 mail for AI Inbox via Microsoft Graph — the Microsoft counterpart of inbox-multi, with the same routes and paging contract. Sign-in is PKCE with a public client ID (client.json, no secret). The list/search/thread routes are METADATA ONLY and are the agent-safe surface; /messages/{id}/body returns attacker-authored CONTENT for a human reader behind a quarantined view only. Writes are limited to read state, flags and folder moves (archive, Deleted Items) with undo; it never requests Mail.Send and never deletes permanently.
author: mchatai-labs
_status: PARKED 2026-09-26 — built and tested, not shipped (owner decision: surface area). `platforms` is empty on purpose: the Microservice Store lists only manifests that declare "mchatai-shell", so this service cannot be offered to anyone while parked. To un-park, restore ["mchatai-shell"] — see mchatai_macOS/PLATFORM_ROADMAP.md item 2g.
